title: Run analytics
subtitle: Current state, hypothesis testing and action outcomes.
empty: Start a run in the Control tab
emptyDetail: Measurements appear here once telemetry arrives.
unavailableDetail: This run does not include analytics. Basic telemetry is still available.
staleDetail: Telemetry freshness is unconfirmed. Current motion and ongoing verification cannot be confirmed.
pendingMeasurement: The result will appear after the verification pass ends.
provisional: The algorithm evaluates independent measurements. The experiment is not complete yet.
chartEmpty: At least two measurements are needed
chartNote: Simulation time. Missing observations break the line. The last {{count}} points are retained; this is not a complete archive.
phaseNote: Phases use observed movement. Stationary does not imply blocked. Planning latency uses wall time; transport timeouts are not counted separately.
summaryNote: The planner receives the same compact summary at the next decision.
waitingExperimentDetail: The run is in progress. A prediction and verification action will appear when the first experiment starts.
noExperimentDetail: This run has no recorded experiment.
lastExperimentDetail: The last experiment remains visible until a new verification starts.
interruptedExperiment: Verification is no longer active. No final outcome was recorded.
